data.name: Systems Engineer
locations: D774 GBR - New Malden - Burlington House
data.jobDescription:
UK CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION: Yes

RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Systems Engineer

Location: New Malden (hybrid working)

Salary: £65,000 - £72,000

What’s Your Possible?

At Northrop Grumman UK, you will help shape the technology and solutions of tomorrow. As part of our team, you will contribute to solving some of the world’s most complex challenges. This is what we call Defining Possible.

This mindset powers our innovation, our impact, and your career development.

The Opportunity

This is more than just a job; it’s a mission.

As a Systems Engineer, you will play a central role in delivering Systems Engineering activities across key defence programmes. You will support the full engineering lifecycle, from understanding customer needs through to system design, integration, acceptance and delivery.

You’ll work within our Defence Systems Engineering team, supporting programmes critical to UK national security, including multi‑domain command and control systems used across the Royal Navy and internationally. Your expertise will directly influence technical quality, design assurance and programme success.

What You Will Do

  • Lead, conduct and deliver Systems Engineering work packages across the project lifecycle.
  • Produce and review technical documentation in line with programme schedules.
  • Plan, prepare and deliver key design reviews including SRR, PDR and CDR.
  • Manage technical aspects of suppliers, ensuring alignment with requirements and design baselines.
  • Review technical documentation from customers and suppliers, providing challenge and assurance.
  • Integrate effectively with Hardware, Mechanical, Software, V&V, ILS, Cybersecurity and Safety teams.
  • Provide technical leadership to deliver work packages on time, to cost and quality.
  • Support risk management, opportunity assessments, bids, proposals and estimation activities.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Degree in Systems, Software, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • 3–5 years’ experience in systems engineering within defence, maritime, aerospace or a regulated environment.
  • Experience of system requirements, design, integration, acceptance and analysis.
  • Knowledge of control systems, PLC/SCADA and operational technology.
  • Experience with Model‑Based Design and tools such as Enterprise Architect.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder skills with the ability to influence at all levels.
  • Experience in requirements management tools such as DOORS.
  • Understanding of the marine environment, environmental standards and safety‑related systems.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of V&V activities including environmental and EMC testing.
  • INCOSE ASE or CSEP accreditation.

If you feel inspired by the role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, you must meet the nationality and residency requirements for UK Security Check (SC) clearance.
You must be able to gain and maintain SC clearance.
For questions, contact our recruitment team at talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com

Benefits

  • Flexible and hybrid working options, including a compressed fortnight with every other Friday off
  • Private healthcare
  • Cash health plan
  • Holiday buy and sell options
  • Career development, mentoring and professional training
  • Performance‑related bonuses

Why Join Us?

A Mission to Believe In
Work on technology that protects national security and supports operations across land, sea, air, space and cyberspace.

A Place to Belong and Thrive
Bring your authentic self to work and join an inclusive community supported by employee networks and partnerships across defence, engineering and wellbeing.

Your Career, Your Way
Shape your career journey with diverse roles, structured development, mentoring and opportunities to grow your expertise.

Ready to Apply?

Yes – Submit your application online.
Possibly – Contact our team for more information: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com
Not right now – Explore other opportunities across Northrop Grumman UK. We are growing nationwide.

Northrop Grumman is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce, and encourages individuals from all backgrounds and all abilities to apply and consider becoming a part of our diverse and inclusive workforce.
